# package device

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/device"
```

Package device models virtual KNX devices: an individual address and group objects (communication objects) with their datapoint type, group addresses, communication flags and current value. A [Device](#type-device) reacts to group telegrams as a KNX device's application layer does: it stores written values, answers reads and takes over responses, according to the flags.

This is the application layer of a device only. It does not emulate a KNX TP device: no physical layer, no transport connections, no management (memory, properties, programming).

```go
	// onChange is called after a telegram changed an object.

}
```

Device is a virtual device: an individual address and group objects.

#### func (Device) Add

```go
func (d *Device) Add(objs ...*GroupObject) *Device
```

Add adds group objects.

#### func (Device) Handle

```go
func (d *Device) Handle(f *cemi.LData) []*cemi.LData
```

Handle processes a group telegram (an L\_Data frame to a group address) and returns the frames the device sends in reaction: at most one A\_GroupValue\_Response per read, from the first object with the C and R flags and a value. Frames to individual addresses, from the device itself, and services other than group values are ignored.

#### func (Device) Object

```go
func (d *Device) Object(name string) (*GroupObject, bool)
```

Object returns the group object of that name.

#### func (Device) Objects

```go
func (d *Device) Objects() []*GroupObject
```

Objects returns the group objects.

#### func (Device) OnChange

```go
func (d *Device) OnChange(f func(Event))
```

OnChange sets the handler called, synchronously, after a telegram changed a group object. It must not block.

#### func (Device) Transmit

```go
func (d *Device) Transmit(o *GroupObject, v any) (*cemi.LData, error)
```

Transmit sets the value of a group object and returns the A\_GroupValue\_Write telegram to its sending address the device sends, if the object has the C and T flags (nil otherwise).

### type Flags

```go
type Flags uint8
```

Flags are the communication flags of a group object.

```go
const (
	// FlagCommunication (C) links the object to the bus at all.
	FlagCommunication Flags = 1 << iota
	// FlagRead (R) answers A_GroupValue_Read with the object's value.
	FlagRead
	// FlagWrite (W) accepts A_GroupValue_Write.
	FlagWrite
	// FlagTransmit (T) sends the value when the application changes it.
	FlagTransmit
	// FlagUpdate (U) takes over the value of A_GroupValue_Response.
	FlagUpdate
	// FlagReadOnInit (I) reads the value from the bus on start.
	FlagReadOnInit
)
```

Communication flags.
